title: Anatomy of Form & Perspective
medium: Charcoal & Graphite on 220gsm Ivory Cartridge Paper
concept: An exploration into the biomechanical geometry of the human hand deconstructed into rectilinear volumes. In preparing for design entrance examinations, I aimed to study not just surface anatomy, but how organic skeletal structures can be interpreted as spatial architectural units interacting with a dynamic perspective grid.

processSteps.title: Isometric Grid Construction
processSteps.description: Plotted a 3-point perspective matrix to map finger joints and phalanges onto Cartesian space.

processSteps.title: Skeletal vs. Muscular Volume
processSteps.description: Contrasted anatomical bone density with volumetric blocks to test grasp and tension.

processSteps.title: Cross-Hatching & Chiaroscuro
processSteps.description: Utilized vine charcoal and 6B graphite for deep tonal contrast indicating surface plane orientation.

title: Lumina — Tactile Light & Pulp Form
medium: Hand-cast Recycled Paper Pulp, Formed Brass Wireframe, 2700K LED
concept: Lumina investigates the interplay of raw tactile materiality and ambient diffuse illumination. Crafted by layering hand-pulped unbleached cotton rag over a bent brass tension armature, the undulating organic surfaces filter light unevenly, celebrating biological asymmetry and warmth in contemporary living spaces.

processSteps.title: Wireframe Armature Bending
processSteps.description: Formed continuous 3mm brass rod to create a self-supporting organic tensile skeleton.

processSteps.title: Pulp Formulation & Slurry Layering
processSteps.description: Blended recycled cotton rag and abaca fiber to achieve variable translucency and fibrous texture.

processSteps.title: Luminance & Diffusion Testing
processSteps.description: Tested diffusion angles with soft 2700K illumination to avoid harsh glare and evoke calmness.

title: Semilla — Biomimetic Hydration Vessel
medium: Slip-cast Matte Ceramic, Natural Cork Stopper, Charcoal Filter
concept: Inspired by the longitudinal grooves of protective seed pods, Semilla redesigns table water storage. The undulating fluted profile is not merely decorative; it provides an intuitive tactile grip that accommodates varying hand sizes without requiring a conventional handle, while the thermal properties of raw ceramic keep water cool.

processSteps.title: Seed Pod Morphological Analysis
processSteps.description: Analyzed ribbed seed husks to identify natural ridges that resist rotational slip in the hand.

processSteps.title: Ergonomic Hand-Grip Form Studies
processSteps.description: Iterated through 6 blue foam lathe models to locate thumb placement and balance center.

processSteps.title: Ceramic Slip-Casting & Cork Integration
processSteps.description: Cast with unglazed exterior slip for a velvet touch, paired with a sustainably harvested cork seal.
